data.explanation: Your US bank needs to re-confirm that you live outside the United States. Fill out the enclosed address certification form and mail or upload it by the date the bank states (January 15, 2027). If it doesn't arrive in time, the bank says it will restrict your online account access until the form is received. Keep a copy of what you send as proof, and contact the bank if you're unsure how to upload the form.
